summary: Jupiter Neurosciences (JUNS) filed an 8-K reporting a non-binding term sheet with PharmAla Biotech for exclusive U.S. rights to ALA-002, a next-generation MDMA formulation. Upfront consideration is $3.33M (1.5M cash + $1.83M stock with a 180-day lock-up; JUNS may elect all-cash). Additional milestones include $3.33M on Phase 3 initiation and $20M on FDA approval, plus commercialization milestones up to $33.33M tied to net sales thresholds. The parties aim for a definitive agreement within 90 days, subject to due diligence. Watch for completion risk, as the term sheet is non-binding and JUNS must secure financing for cash consideration.
